preexecution_review: Full driver and reused base read before execution; exact driver SHA supplied to launcher and checked by driver.

fd_adaptation_contract.change: Only seed reply reading switched from text-wrapper readline after select to raw FD newline buffering.
fd_adaptation_contract.deadline_implementation: monotonic()+15; each selector wait only remaining time; reads retain bytes after first newline for next reply.
seed_checks_preserved: SDK PID absent before first native login

normal_navigation_samples.byte_identity: same as untouched page PNG, plain and ANSI

raw_capture_caption_correction: captures.json uses the generic no-input capture note also on normal-c/h; those two had ordinary c/h input immediately before capture, as recorded by driver/main and this review. Original captions are preserved, not silently rewritten.

actual_pixel_review.method: Both distinct whole-PNG contents personally viewed with view_image detail original, not solely tool thumbnails. All five untouched frames and normal-h hash-identical, so share exactly the reviewed first-frame pixels.
actual_pixel_review.untouched_page: Header 历史, chat entries 导/导航/导航测试群, and footer 已连接 have recognizable Chinese glyphs rather than hollow missing-glyph boxes.
actual_pixel_review.contacts_page: Header 历史, contact 观/观察 and footer 已连接 are recognizable Chinese glyphs.
actual_pixel_review.result: Historic attempt2 initial-B missing glyphs were not reproduced in this one-client sample. No visible waiting-time transition: all five untouched frames match exactly, and normal h returns the same pixels.

font_evidence.config: Software frontend; font_with_fallback DejaVu Sans Mono, Lily Han Sans HW SC, Noto Color Emoji; 12pt; 96dpi; Unicode9; 120x40.
font_evidence.readonly_contrast_command: fc-match 'Lily Han Sans HW SC'; same command with XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR set to this run's config/cache/data/runtime directories.
font_evidence.interpretation_limit: Default-shell fc-match cannot demonstrate the same match under native isolated XDG. Neither fc-match result identifies WezTerm's actual per-character fallback font; no font was installed or configuration changed for this probe.
font_evidence.wezterm_log_observation: Only unhandled DecPrivateMode2031 and unknown CSI?996n warnings in the recorded log; absence of font warnings does not prove a correct font or explain the prior transient.

cleanup.tui_exit_limit: TUI is tmux-owned rather than a driver Popen; its PID absence is verified, but no independent TUI exit code was captured. Driver actual exit0 is not a claim of TUI exit0.
cleanup.base_cleanup_caveat: Inherited cleanup.json records the intermediate retained database before the wrapper's explicit drop; final-cleanup.json follows successful drop and readonly pg_database absence check. Both are kept.

first_preflight_preserved.reason: Self-added PGHOST guard rejected original test environment which correctly uses libpq default local socket. Root authorized removing that irrelevant guard; no PGenv or production source changed.

historical_evidence_preserved: Committed four-client-native-daily attempt2 002-login.png and 004-incoming-D.png remain unchanged; this fresh one-TUI sequence is supplementary and never substitutes its initial normal frame for the historical anomaly.
limits: One fresh single-client run cannot establish absence of an intermittent or four-client concurrency-dependent glyph issue.
No anomalous initial frame in this run means waiting alone versus navigation redraw recovery was not tested on an actual missing-glyph state.
Current pixels and original valid ANSI do not prove whether the historical cause was terminal fallback/cache, asynchronous painting, capture timing or TUI repaint behavior.
No production defect or production fix is asserted; no sanitizer gate or complete daily-business acceptance is claimed.
This probe makes no AT-SPI tree-read success claim.
next_action: Keep the historical anomaly plus this non-reproduction evidence. If a further diagnostic is needed, request a same four-client-concurrency reproduction with identical owned XDG and explicit per-process font/runtime evidence; do not alter production or force repaint merely to erase a candidate.
